translations.web: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
translations.bsb: Their bows will dash young men to pieces; they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb; they will not look with pity on the children.
